description: Create a new API key for your account. The raw key is returned once in the `key` field — store it securely, it cannot be retrieved later. Get the new key's id from list_api_keys. This session keeps using the current key until you change RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY or rerun `rentahuman-mcp setup`. Maximum 25 active keys per account; revoke one first if you hit the limit. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY to be set.

name.description: A descriptive name for this key (e.g., 'production', 'dev-testing', 'backup'). Max 50 characters.

name: create_api_key
title: Create API key
